# ADO303: runtime-expression-partial

A runtime expression $[ ] is mixed with other text.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Category** | Expressions |
| **Default severity** | warning |
| **Enabled by default** | yes |
| **Checked on** | each original source file, before template expansion |

## Description

A runtime expression must take up the entire right side of a variable definition.

## Example

Problem:

```yaml
variables:
  tag: v-$[counter('v', 1)]
```

Instead:

```yaml
variables:
  n: $[counter('v', 1)]
  tag: v-$(n)
```

## Configuration

Change the severity or turn the rule off in `.adolint.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  ADO303: off   # off | info | warning | error
```

Or on the command line: `adolint lint --disable ADO303` or `--enable ADO303`.

Suppress a single finding with a comment on the line before it (or `disable-line` at the end of the line):

```yaml
# adolint:disable-next-line ADO303
```
